name.description: The name the caller asks to be called

preferred_language.description: The language the caller wants to speak

callback_number.description: The phone number the caller wants to be called back on

email.description: The email address the caller wants written follow-ups sent to

timezone.description: The caller's timezone or city, for scheduling

account_tier.description: The plan or membership level the caller is on

consents_to_recording.description: Whether the caller agreed to have calls recorded

prefers_response_style.description: How the caller likes answers, such as brief or step by step

open_issue.description: A problem the caller reported that is not resolved yet

owns_product.description: A product or service the caller owns or subscribes to

uses_technology.description: A device, platform, or tool the caller uses
